race.comment: RING BEARER (5) shoulders a strong record over the track and trip, and his fourth at the Gold Coast was good when doing his best work late. Keeps the claim and should be at his top now. WEEKEND ARTIST (9) is in form and beat home RING BEARER at the latest. Is 1/1 on track and only needs to hold his form to be right there again. MAKAMAE (16) drops back from tougher and boasts a handy record on the home track. No reason she can't play a major role. LARUSSO (12) was fifth in a BM60 last start at Gold Coast, beaten two lengths after racing keenly early. Gets weight relief and handles wet ground. Well placed and in the mix.
